# Source Of Truth

## Rule

Git/docs/tests/issues are source of truth. Memory0 is not source of truth.
Memory0 provides approved, scoped context only.

## Matrix

| Topic | Authoritative source |
|---|---|
| Requirements | PRD, accepted issue, acceptance criteria |
| Architecture | ADR and architecture document |
| Contracts | `contracts/**` |
| Code | Git branch, PR diff, merge commit |
| Task state | GitHub issue and PR |
| Tests | CI and test evidence |
| Release | Release manifest |
| Memory | Approved scoped memory with source reference |
